{{Quote|He died on the planet Giju during the war&mdash;along with the rest of my command. A stupid, useless battle in an increasingly violent and useless war.|[[Sha Koon]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Purge: Seconds to Die">''[[Purge – Seconds to Die]]''</ref>}}
'''Giju''' was the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], it was on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] and was one endpoint of the [[Giju Run/Legends|Giju Run]]. Giju was an aquatic-type world with large bodies of [[Water/Legends|water]] and associated terrain including: expansive oceans, islands, marshes, and glaciers. Giju had many spaceports and manufacturing centers.

==History==
The [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] developed [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] around [[27,500 BBY]] and colonized many nearby [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in what became [[Herglic Space/Legends|Herglic Space]], establishing the [[Herglic Trade Empire]]. The Trade Empire joined the Republic around [[13,000 BBY]], and in [[12,720 BBY]], the Herglic established contact with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists of nearby [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].

[[File:BattleOfGiju-STD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Sha Koon]] and her troops during the [[Battle of Giju (Clone Wars)|battle]] of Giju]]
[[Sha Koon]] fought on the world during the [[Battle of Giju (Clone Wars)|Battle of Giju]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to repel a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] invasion force.

Giju suffered under the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], its manufacturing centers<ref name="DFRS" /> and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]<ref name="UAA" /> among the first to be commandeered by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. The Herglics [[Battle of Giju|attempted to resist]], but the one-sided slaughter that ensued convinced them to submit to the will of the Empire with their infrastructure still intact.<ref name="DFRS" /> Herglic Space was then granted nominal status as an [[Allied Region]],<ref name="TEA" /> and although they were denied the rights given to Humans, the Herglics were able to live comfortably as they labored to supply the Imperial war machine. When the Empire abandoned Giju, the Herglics were able to resume their role in galactic trade with relative ease.<ref name="DFRS" />

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and the establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Giju quickly joined the new galactic government.
